item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukrainian naval drones have repeatedly struck Russian warships at Libya's Benghazi port, including a recent attack that hit a Russian vessel and prompted Zelensky to say Ukraine can attack wherever it wants. In Ukraine, civilian casualties in 2026 are already far higher than in previous years, with a deadly overnight Russian apartment strike killing at least nine people and a blast in central Kyiv injuring several, including a foreign national. Russian forces continue targeting Ukrainian civilian sites, while Ukraine also used drones against a refinery in Novoshakhtinsk. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank: the situation
item.description:
Settler attacks on Palestinian villages in the West Bank continue, with Israeli officials labeling them as Jewish terrorism and urging police, not the IDF, to intervene. Israeli forces have detained dozens during a raid on a West Bank refugee camp and have been accused of a 350% surge in attacks on medics there. In Gaza, Israeli bombardment has been described as creating a toxic wasteland, cutting off vital hearing-aid supplies and prompting reports of environmental crimes affecting 99% of the enclave. The conflict has resulted in 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah: the situation
item.description:
Israeli soldiers demolished houses in southern Lebanon and then withdrew, allowing Lebanese villagers to return to damaged homes, while Lebanese President Aoun demanded Israel pull back and warned Iran against interference. An IDF spokesperson visited a Lebanese school, prompting outrage, and the IDF later said sirens in two border communities were false alarms. Israel publicly sent best wishes to Lebanon on its Independence Day, which was observed quietly. The Lebanese army arrested three individuals accused of smuggling explosives from Syria, and the conflict caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthis have stepped up missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Rabigh refinery and launching missiles toward Riyadh, while the Saudi-led coalition intercepted multiple missiles and a drone in the Red Sea and western Yemen. Saudi forces responded by striking Yemen's Hodeidah port city, killing ten civilians, and the coalition also reported intercepting a missile in the western region. Houthi fighters claimed seizure of large weapons stockpiles in Mokha and warned of further threats to Red Sea shipping. Dozens of children were killed in Yemen amid the intensified fighting, and 918 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:
Security personnel continue to be targeted in Syria, with attacks injuring four guards in Suwayda and a drone strike wounding four more, while a landmine blast in Idlib killed five children. A cluster munition killed a child in southern Syria, and Syrian authorities arrested a church guard and other suspects in a theft at Our Lady of Peace Church in Homs. Lebanon’s army seized 264 kilograms of explosives near the border and Syrian officials intercepted weapons smuggling attempts, reflecting ongoing cross-border illicit activity. Egypt reiterated support for Syria’s unity and sovereignty. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
Iraqi security forces have entered Jurf al-Sakhar, deploying Brigade 72 and establishing checkpoints as Kataib Hezbollah begins a phased withdrawal, while the militia announced its own timetable for leaving. A power-station explosion in Basra killed at least four people and police arrested officers and suspects linked to oil-pipeline smuggling between Dhi Qar and Basra. Senior ISIS leaders were killed in operations in eastern and northeastern Iraq and a new Shiite militia, Asa'ib Al-Jihad, announced its formation. Iran carried out a strike that wounded two people in Bahrain, prompting Saudi condemnation, and the KRG has asked internet providers to block Telegram. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The RSF also continued ground offensives, attacking aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. Charity kitchens in Khartoum are closing, leaving displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, in severe hardship. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:
Rebel and SPLA-IO forces have intensified attacks across South Sudan, killing civilians in Tonj East, Warrap State, and other locations, with recent incidents reporting 24 deaths including children and women. Cattle-theft raids have also turned lethal, leaving dozens dead and prompting fear of missing persons after assaults on islands such as Miny Island in Jonglei. The violence has spread to the political sphere, with the brother of former Juba Mayor James Allah-Jabu dying and the former vice president Igga announcing the death. The crisis now includes large-scale killings reported in Ruweng and ongoing insecurity ahead of the postponed 2026 election. According to UCDP, there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024.

In the Amhara region, the Fano insurgency continues to threaten water security in the Nile Basin, adding a new dimension to the Horn of Africa conflict. The United States reversed its stance, now funding UN military support in Somalia for another year after previously withdrawing that funding. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The junta continues large-scale attacks on Rohingya civilians, including a bridge-destruction campaign in Arakan and the advance of a 108‑kilometre fence on the Bangladesh border. It also admitted corruption in its conscription system and began actions against nearly two hundred officials. There were 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
